'''Marg Sonat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] working for [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sard Nightbringer]].

==Biography==
Sonat was present on [[Rantine Space Station/Legends|Rantine Space Station]] in the [[Shoten Lounge]] when he meet a pair of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]]. He hired them to transport a large crate on their freighter from Rantine Space Station to [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]]. While they packed up their ship, he went to talk to his boss [[Sard Nightbringer]] about the plan to auction off an experimental personal shield generator that she had looted from [[Imperial Research and Development Station T-1583]] and use the profits to force the Empire to leave the Tamarin sector.. He expressed his misgivings about her plan and wanted to use the profits to enrich himself. Afterwards, he met with [[Pari' Notgoth]] and convinced him to work together so they could steal the device and credits after the auction. He decided to have Morgotou killed so Notgoth could take his place at the auction.

Once onboard the ''[[Stellar Mermaid]]'', Sonat attended the auction and led the losing bidders out of the room after [[Natja]] successfully won the bidding. He later sabotaged the ship, causing a hull breach and killing Nightbringer.
